name: ksdensity
expr: [f, xi, bw] = ksdensity(x, pts); fb = ksdensity(x, pts, 'Kernel', 'box'); ft = ksdensity(x, pts, 'Kernel', 'triangle'); fe = ksdensity(x, pts, 'Kernel', 'epanechnikov'); fc = ksdensity(x, pts, 'Function', 'cdf'); fs = ksdensity(x, pts, 'Function', 'survivor'); fw = ksdensity(x, pts, 'Weights', w);
comment: Sig: [f, xi, bw] = ksdensity(x[, pts][, 'Bandwidth'/'Kernel'/'Function'/'NumPoints'/'Weights', val, ...]). 4 kernels (normal/box/triangle/epanechnikov) with MATLAB-style σ²=1 bandwidth normalization (h × sqrt(unit-σ²-inverse) for finite-support kernels). Function modes: pdf (default), cdf, survivor, cumhazard. Weights normalized to sum to 1. Default bandwidth via mad(x)/0.6745 fallback to iqr(x)/1.349 (matches MATLAB's bw exactly). Censoring/Support/BoundaryCorrection deferred.
